behaviors.search-assignees: Open the Assignee filter and search the people list by name.
behaviors.filter-by-assignee: Choose a person or Unassigned to show only their tasks, with task counts shown beside filter options.
behaviors.combine-filters: Apply an assignee and status filter together so the board shows tasks matching both.
behaviors.empty-filter-state: Choose Ana Lima to see the new “Nothing assigned to Ana Lima yet” empty state.
behaviors.clear-filters: Use Clear filters to reset both filters and return to all four seeded tasks.

history.notes: Assignee choices are located by their listbox option names, and counts are included in the option labels. Clear filters has both a toolbar button and an empty-state button, so the tour clicks the first match in each relevant state.

I scoped options to the `.dd-option-label` text because listbox options are exposed as `li[role=option]`, which Playwright’s `getByRole('option')` did not resolve in the failure. Status uses the first Status-labeled select so the toolbar filter is targeted instead of a task card’s status control.

history.error: Check failed: Priya option shows its task count
history.notes: The previous failure came from trying to select a list option after its popup had already closed. This version clears the search and chooses Priya within the still-open dropdown; it scopes status to the toolbar so task-card status selectors cannot create a strict-locator collision.

The task-count check runs after reopening the Assignee menu because its options disappear when a selection closes the menu. The clear action targets the toolbar button to avoid the duplicate button in the empty state.
